Online Complaint Summary

2/14/26 12:17 AM Page 1 of 4

Board: Medical Board of California
License Type: Physician's and Surgeon's
Complaint Number: 8002026126988
Incident Date: 11/17/2025
Description: I was admitted to the outpatient program at Roots Through Recovery located at 3939 Atlantic Ave #102, Long Beach, CA 90807 under the care of Dr. Salisu Adejo Aikoye (License A 154761).

1. Unsafe Prescribing:
During intake, I informed Dr. Aikoye that my psychiatrist was prescribing Gabapentin. He ignored this and prescribed Depakote without consulting my other provider, creating a dangerous risk of over-sedation.

2. Admission Without Intent to Treat (Negligence):
Dr. Aikoye formally admitted me to the outpatient program even after explicitly stating he would not assist with my medically necessary taper unless I upgraded to inpatient care. This created a contradictory situation where I was "admitted" for treatment that the physician had already refused to provide.

3. Unprofessional Conduct:
When I mentioned I had successfully used the 'Bernese Method' after two other clinics refused to enroll me due to poly substance abuse, he jokingly remarked "man, you're hurting my business" -- (by getting better without his expensive inpatient care).

4. Dangerous Advice:
Despite admitting me to the program, he refused to manage my taper and explicitly advised me to just continue purchasing Xanax off of the street to taper myself because "the DOJ has gotten stricter". This confused me.

Dr. Aikoye established a doctor-patient relationship by admitting me and prescribing medication, yet refused to treat my condition and advised illegal substance use. I request an investigation into this negligent facility.
